newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 23.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 23.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones fell 33.87 points to 6,850.03 PLDT's ADR also rose $1 3/4 to $59.
* On Wednesday, the peso weakened to 26.325 to a U.S. dollar from 26.315.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,275.83, down 3.40.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average rate was steady at 10.53215 percent.

* Four major conglomerates, Benpres Holdings Corp, Ayala Corp, Aboitiz Equity Ventures Inc, and Metro Pacific Corp, pass the technical aspects of their bids, paving the way for their participation in the opening of financial bids for the privatisation of the Metropolitan Waterworks and Sewerage System.
* Bank of the Philippine Islands says it doubled its net profits last year to 3.99 billion pesos after the merger with Citytrust Banking Corp.
* A Reuters poll shows that Ayala Land is expected to post a net profit growth of 37 percent in 1996 to reach 4.25 billion pesos from 3.11 billion pesos the previous year.
* Fil-Estate Properties Inc, a subsidiary of Fil-Estate Land Inc, says it will put up a mixed-use complex in Manila's Makati business district.
* Manila Chronicle says United Paragon Mining Corp reports that its gold production in 1996 reached 42,687 ounces, up by 35 percent form the level in 1995.
